description: The chart illustrates the performance of three models, Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale, on the QA-1 task, categorized by the correctness of their responses. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of responses, ranging from 0 to approximately 1, with a linear scale and no explicit units or tick labels, while the vertical axis lists the model names. Each model's performance is represented by a stacked bar, divided into three segments: Correct (dark purple), Partially Correct (medium blue), and Incorrect (light blue). Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B has a Correct proportion of 0.88, Partially Correct of 0.08, and Incorrect of 0.04, while EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale both have a Correct proportion of 0.96, Partially Correct of 0, and Incorrect of 0.04. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively displays the relative performance of the three models, with EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale showing identical and superior performance compared to Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B.
